placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Aerospace Bristol brings the region's aircraft and engineering heritage into focus. Concorde is the headline attraction, with other displays helping families discover the people and ideas behind flight.

Our family idea: invite children to choose a favourite aircraft detail and sketch it after the visit. Leave enough time to explore the wider museum as well as the Concorde hangar.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Aircraft enthusiasts and children who enjoy engineering.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Museum displays, cafe and an outdoor aircraft-themed play area.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Visitor parking is on site. Follow the museum's entrance directions from Hayes Way.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Admission is ticketed. Check current prices and access arrangements; the postcode alone may not lead to the vehicle entrance.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Aerospace Bristol, Hayes Way, Patchway, Bristol, BS34 5BZ
placevisitmap.travelNote: Visitor parking is on site. Follow the museum's entrance directions from Hayes Way. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
